entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be connected to the right department.
Uh... returns, I guess? I think so.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, you're speaking with Isaac. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I need to send something back. I have this helmet, and it's all just a bit much. I'm so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly help you with that. I just need to pull up your account. Do you have an order number, or can I get your full name?
Yes, um, the name is Sarah Jenkins. I think... let me find the number... oh, it's all so confusing. Can't you just help me? I just want to return it.
Of course, Sarah. No problem at all. I see your recent order here for the AeroFlow helmet. What specifically is the issue with it?

It's just... the color wasn't what I thought it would be from the website, and I got worried about the safety ratings... I don't know if I picked the right one. The box is unopened, I haven't even touched it. I just feel so overwhelmed.
I completely understand, these things can be tricky. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Alright, Sarah, I've got good news. I see the helmet was delivered 83 days ago, and our policy allows for returns on standard items for up to 90 days. So you are well within the window.
Oh, really? That's a relief! I was so worried I was stuck with it. Thank you.

You're very welcome. I'm happy to process this for you right now. I'll email a pre-paid return label to the address we have on file. Just print it, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
That sounds so much easier. Thank you, Isaac. You've been a great help.
It's my pleasure, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're welcome. Have a wonderful day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
